stories.title: mobile-release-standards: MR-15 runtime audit and MR-16 toolchain guard as release gates
stories.description: Part of #376. Two rules in a new Release gates section, worded so they hold whatever tool built the binary or ships its updates: MR-15 (every store version still in use needs an update path, inventoried from the store releases and audited before each store release as it will stand once the release ships) and MR-16 (the Xcode of any build machine where it can change between builds is pinned, the build fails on a mismatch, and DTXcode and DTSDKName are compared before reading code). Each with its rule-index row, heading, Rule line and ARC-023 enforcement line.
stories.testEvidence: test/iw-2026-10-20-b.test.ts describe("#376 mobile-release-standards: ..."), 5 tests: red against the unchanged document (5 of 5 failed), green after the edit; the review fixes (R1, R4, R5, R16) were asserted red first and green after. test/eas-store-deploy.test.ts (rule-index and body consistency, 13 tests) and test/up02-d-runtime-placeholders.test.ts (6) pass with MR-15 and MR-16 in place; the spell cites both IDs (asserted in the lifecycle block). Full suite green (2026-10-22).

stories.title: spell-eas-store-deploy: EAS Update lifecycle section in four parts
stories.description: Closes #376. A new section after the Shared EAS Preamble: (1) OTA lifecycle and stranded runtimes, with the runtime audit citing MR-15 (inventoried from the store builds, the first step of both stores' repeat deployments, its result in the release report), the crash-loop first aid and the backport recipe; (2) the store update prompt pattern; (3) toolchain pinning for any machine running eas build --local whose Xcode can change, with the guard step and its read citing MR-16; (4) when to set latest, and the minimum. The #298 read-back uses update:view --json. The consumer session's specifics in one dated observations block; the {XCODE_VERSION} placeholder; the scope line names EAS Update.
stories.testEvidence: test/iw-2026-10-20-b.test.ts describe("#376 spell-eas-store-deploy: the EAS Update lifecycle"), 11 tests: red against the unchanged spell (10 of 10 in the first pass), green after the edit; the review fixes (R1 to R5, R7, R10 to R12, R16 to R18, the scope line; second pass N1 to N4 and N6) were asserted red first and green after. test/iw-2026-10.test.ts keeps its anchors, its #298 read-back assertion updated for R2. Commands and fields checked against the eas-cli source and changelog, the expo-updates error-recovery documentation and the App Store lookup on 2026-10-22 (architecture, Evidence). Full suite green (2026-10-22).

stories.title: spell-test: visual verification for HTML and UI deliverables (step 4a)
stories.description: Closes #375. Step 4a between the acceptance-criteria and evidence steps: local HTTP with production's headers, never file://, and the declared-charset check; headless captures at 1440, 390 and 320 px in dark and light with and without reduced motion, after animations settle; a console read for script and CSP errors; a like-with-like before/after comparison; the differing captures kept in the design record, never one with a secret, none in a sensitive repository; the NOT RUN outcome. A Visual Verification block in the evidence template and a Rules line. The routine is run once against src/assets/sign-in/*.html before it ships.
stories.testEvidence: test/iw-2026-10-20-b.test.ts describe("#375 spell-test: ..."), 8 tests: red against the unchanged spell (7 of 7 in the first pass), green after the edit; the review fixes (R6, R8, R9, R13 to R15, R17; second pass N5) were asserted red first and green after. The step was run once on src/assets/sign-in/*.html with Playwright 1.63 and the production headers: 36 captures (3 pages x 3 widths x 2 schemes x 2 motion settings), 0 console errors or warnings. Controls: a blocking policy over HTTP produced 1 console error naming the directive; the same page from file:// produced none; a UTF-8 page with no declared charset decoded as UTF-8 from file:// and as windows-1252 over HTTP text/html without a charset (3 variants); two captures of one cell were byte-identical across launches, and the review reproduced all 36 byte for byte. Not exercised: the color-scheme half of the matrix, because these pages are dark-only (all 9 dark/light pairs identical). Captures were kept outside the repository: no page changed in this wave. Full suite green (2026-10-22).

stories.title: Release 1.12.3: parity, version bump, changelog, full suite and CI
stories.description: Regenerate the root copies and shims, bump 1.12.2 to 1.12.3 (a patch: no new distributable file), add the CHANGELOG entry, run the full suite and every check the CI runs.
stories.testEvidence: 1.12.2 -> 1.12.3 (patch), CHANGELOG [1.12.3]. Local, after the review fixes: check:version-bump, check:self-host-parity (351 items), check:adr-references, check:spell-catalog, check:report-template, check:citations, check:stale-claims, check:followups, lint, typecheck and typecheck:all pass; build passes (before the fixes; Markdown-only since). npm test at default budgets (the pre-push suite): 147 files, 2377 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed, 143 s. npm run test:coverage -- --testTimeout=20000 --retry=1 before the fixes: 2375 passed, coverage 92.08% statements, 87.07% branches, 93.97% functions, 93.27% lines; the fixes changed no source code. One earlier default-budget run under load timed out four pre-existing real-git tests, which passed alone. CI on the pull request is the confirming run.
